messages:
alex: opened a docs PR for Private/VPC installs — migration guide for moving from local PKCS#11 HSM to the new HSM-proxy gateway. includes port matrix, airgap install steps, and a short Python SDK example. would appreciate reviews before i land it tomorrow.
priya: can you paste the PR link? also do we have smoke-test steps in the PR body? ops requires conn checks for private/* changes.
alex: PR is https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1934. i added a checklist but not the explicit commands yet — plan to add conn-check + http health check.
tom: quick read: add NAT hairpin note for customers who run proxy on same subnet as HSM. also call out ports: outbound TLS 443 (to cloud-hsm) and local HSM tunnel TCP 15002. update port matrix.
rachel: minor: examples should live under docs/private/examples not migration/ so folks can find runnable snippets. move the python snippet and add a tiny curl example.
docs-bot: PR 1934 updated by alex — lint: docs ok, linkcheck: 1 broken internal ref (/ops/hsm-proxy -> /ops/hsm-gateway).
alex: thanks bot, fixing link. adding the python SDK snippet now:```python
# example: wrap a migration key with Redwood Python SDK
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
plain = b"customer-key-bytes"
wrapped = client.wrap_key("migration:wrap", plain)
print(wrapped.hex())
```
priya: add a short unwrap example (pseudo) for the gateway side so integrators see server flow. also include a note to keep rotation windows small during migration — we had a case where rotation caused failures mid-transfer.
tom: also add a troubleshooting tip: on RHEL7/RHEL8 older kernels we saw bind errors; recommend checking `sysctl net.core.somaxconn` and if needed set `net.core.somaxconn=1024`. and mention `socat` tcp proxy workaround for testing.
rachel: for airgapped installs, expand the steps: 1) verify checksums 2) unpack bundle 3) import certs to system store 4) start service. include systemd dry-run snippet and checksum command: `sha256sum redwood-proxy-bundle.tar.gz`.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs touching private/* must include smoke test commands in PR description.
alex: added smoke test commands: `./bin/conn-check --endpoint 127.0.0.1:15002` and `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:15002/health`. also added systemd unit example and the unwrap pseudocode per priya. merging after CI green and a quick pass from docs.
priya: i'll review tomorrow morning.
tom: lgtm aside from one nit about wording around "trusted CA" vs "system CA store".
rachel: small ask — include `chronyc tracking` in the airgap preflight checklist (time sync before cert validation).
alex: added chrony check and clarified CA wording. thanks all — planning to merge Friday afternoon unless someone objects. :shipit:
